name: Vasubandhu
shortBio: Indian Buddhist philosopher and co-founder of the Yogacara school whose Abhidharmakosa and Consciousness-Only (vijnapti-matra) treatises mapped the eight layers of consciousness and perceptual projection.
centralQuestion: If all experience arises within the stream of karmically conditioned awareness, how does storehouse consciousness (alaya-vijnana) construct the appearance of dualistic subject and object?

keyWorks.title: Abhidharmakosakarika (Treasury of Abhidharma)
keyWorks.description: Comprehensive dialectical compendium of Buddhist metaphysics, causation, perception, and mental factors.

keyWorks.title: Vimsatika & Trimsika (Twenty & Thirty Verses on Consciousness-Only)
keyWorks.description: Classic Yogacara phenomenology defending cognitive idealism and analyzing the eight consciousnesses.
